# Monoline

> Open-source UI kit: a plain CSS core (@monoline/css) with accessible React components (@monoline/react). Three themes, nine accents, font, corner and density options, no Tailwind, no runtime CSS-in-JS.

Start with AGENTS.md (how to work in this repo) and DESIGN.md (the look and rules). Every component is a folder with source, test, demo and meta.json. Install the packages, or copy one component with npx monoline add <name> (source in registry/<name>.json).

## Docs
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI agents and contributors
- [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md): design rules, tokens, copy
- [registry/index.json](registry/index.json): machine-readable component list

## Components
### layout
- Aspect ratio (aspect-ratio, stable): Keep media or a placeholder at a fixed width-to-height ratio. Source: packages/react/src/components/aspect-ratio/
- Box (box, stable): A div with padding and a thin border mapped to the spacing tokens. Source: packages/react/src/components/box/
- Container (container, stable): Centre content in a column with a sensible maximum width and side padding. Source: packages/react/src/components/container/
- Direction provider (direction-provider, stable): Sets the reading direction (ltr or rtl) once for every Radix-based component below it. Source: packages/react/src/components/direction-provider/
- Flex (flex, stable): A flex container with direction, wrap, align, justify, gap and an inline form. Stack covers the common case. Source: packages/react/src/components/flex/
- Grid (grid, stable): A responsive grid of equal columns with one gap. Source: packages/react/src/components/grid/
- Overflow list (overflow-list, stable): A row of items that shows as many as fit and puts the rest in a '+N' menu. Source: packages/react/src/components/overflow-list/
- Resizable (resizable, stable): Panels separated by handles you drag or move with the keyboard. Source: packages/react/src/components/resizable/
- Scroll area (scroll-area, stable): A scrollable region with thin, themed scrollbars. Source: packages/react/src/components/scroll-area/
- Separator (separator, stable): A thin rule between groups. Source: packages/react/src/components/separator/
- Stack (stack, stable): Lay children out in a column or row with one gap from the spacing scale. Source: packages/react/src/components/stack/

### typography
- Heading (heading, stable): A heading whose level (for structure) is separate from its size (for looks). Source: packages/react/src/components/heading/
- Kbd (kbd, stable): Show a keyboard key or shortcut. Source: packages/react/src/components/kbd/
- Link (link, stable): An underlined link. External links open safely and say so. Source: packages/react/src/components/link/
- Text (text, stable): Body text with a size and tone from the scale. Source: packages/react/src/components/text/

### buttons
- Button (button, stable): Triggers an action. Native button with solid, line, ghost and danger variants. Source: packages/react/src/components/button/
- Button group (button-group, stable): Join related buttons into one segmented bar. Source: packages/react/src/components/button-group/
- Copy button (copy-button, stable): A button that copies a value to the clipboard, shows 'Copied' for a moment and announces it. Source: packages/react/src/components/copy-button/
- Icon button (icon-button, stable): A square button holding only an icon. The accessible name is required. Source: packages/react/src/components/icon-button/
- Segmented control (segmented-control, stable): Pick exactly one option from a short row, shown as joined segments. Source: packages/react/src/components/segmented-control/
- Toggle (toggle, stable): A button that stays pressed or not. Source: packages/react/src/components/toggle/
- Toggle group (toggle-group, stable): A row of toggles where one or several can be on. Source: packages/react/src/components/toggle-group/
- Toolbar (toolbar, stable): A row of related controls that share one tab stop and arrow-key movement. Source: packages/react/src/components/toolbar/

### forms
- Autocomplete (autocomplete, stable): A text field that suggests values while you type and accepts anything you enter. Source: packages/react/src/components/autocomplete/
- Calendar (calendar, stable): A month grid for picking one date. Source: packages/react/src/components/calendar/
- Checkbox (checkbox, stable): A box to turn one choice on or off, with an indeterminate state. Source: packages/react/src/components/checkbox/
- Color picker (color-picker, stable): Choose a colour from preset swatches, the native colour control, or a hex value. Source: packages/react/src/components/color-picker/
- Combobox (combobox, stable): Type to filter a list and pick one option. Source: packages/react/src/components/combobox/
- Date picker (date-picker, stable): A button that opens a calendar and shows the chosen date. Source: packages/react/src/components/date-picker/
- Date range picker (date-range-picker, stable): A button that opens a range calendar and two typed date fields. Source: packages/react/src/components/date-range-picker/
- Field (field, stable): Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA. Source: packages/react/src/components/field/
- Fieldset (fieldset, stable): Group related controls under one legend. Source: packages/react/src/components/fieldset/
- File upload (file-upload, stable): Choose files by browsing or dropping them, and see what is selected. Source: packages/react/src/components/file-upload/
- Form (form, stable): A form wrapper with a submit helper, an error summary that links to invalid fields, and an actions footer. Source: packages/react/src/components/form/
- Input (input, stable): A single-line text field. Source: packages/react/src/components/input/
- Label (label, stable): The visible name of a form control. Source: packages/react/src/components/label/
- Mentions (mentions, stable): A textarea that suggests people when you type @. Source: packages/react/src/components/mentions/
- Multi select (multi-select, stable): Type to filter a list and pick several options, shown as removable tags. Source: packages/react/src/components/multi-select/
- Native select (native-select, stable): The browser select, styled. Best on mobile and for long simple lists. Source: packages/react/src/components/native-select/
- Number input (number-input, stable): A numeric field with decrease and increase buttons. Source: packages/react/src/components/number-input/
- OTP input (otp-input, stable): Enter a one-time code, one digit per box, with paste support. Source: packages/react/src/components/otp-input/
- Password input (password-input, stable): A password field with a show/hide toggle. Source: packages/react/src/components/password-input/
- Radio group (radio-group, stable): Pick exactly one option from a short list. Source: packages/react/src/components/radio-group/
- Range calendar (range-calendar, stable): A month grid for picking a start and an end date. Source: packages/react/src/components/range-calendar/
- Rating (rating, stable): Pick or show a score from 1 to a maximum, as stars. Source: packages/react/src/components/rating/
- Rich text editor (rich-text-editor, beta): A dependency-free rich text editor with a formatting toolbar and sanitized HTML in and out. Source: packages/react/src/components/rich-text-editor/
- Select (select, stable): Pick one value from a list of five or more options. Source: packages/react/src/components/select/
- Slider (slider, stable): Pick a number, or a range, by dragging or with the keyboard. Source: packages/react/src/components/slider/
- Switch (switch, stable): An on/off setting that takes effect immediately. Source: packages/react/src/components/switch/
- Tags input (tags-input, stable): Type text and press Enter or comma to add it as a removable tag. Source: packages/react/src/components/tags-input/
- Textarea (textarea, stable): A multi-line text field. Source: packages/react/src/components/textarea/
- Time field (time-field, stable): Hour, minute and AM/PM segments you step with arrow keys or type into. Source: packages/react/src/components/time-field/
- Time picker (time-picker, stable): Pick a time of day with hour, minute and AM/PM segments, using the browser's own control. Source: packages/react/src/components/time-picker/
- Tree select (tree-select, stable): A select whose options are a nested tree, with search and single or multiple selection. Source: packages/react/src/components/tree-select/

### data-display
- Accordion (accordion, stable): Stacked headings that each show or hide a section. Source: packages/react/src/components/accordion/
- Area chart (area-chart, stable): A line chart filled down to zero, optionally stacked to show a running total. Source: packages/react/src/components/area-chart/
- Avatar (avatar, stable): A person or thing as an image with an initials fallback. Source: packages/react/src/components/avatar/
- Avatar group (avatar-group, stable): Overlap several avatars and show how many more there are. Source: packages/react/src/components/avatar-group/
- Badge (badge, stable): A short status word or count. Source: packages/react/src/components/badge/
- Bar chart (bar-chart, stable): Compare values across categories with vertical or horizontal bars, grouped or stacked. Source: packages/react/src/components/bar-chart/
- Card (card, stable): A bordered group for one thing you can pick up or open. Source: packages/react/src/components/card/
- Carousel (carousel, stable): A row of slides you scroll or step through with buttons. Source: packages/react/src/components/carousel/
- Code block (code-block, stable): A block of code with a copy button. Source: packages/react/src/components/code-block/
- Collapsible (collapsible, stable): Show or hide one region of content from a trigger. Source: packages/react/src/components/collapsible/
- Data grid (data-grid, beta): A virtualised, keyboard-navigable grid for very large data sets, with sortable columns and row selection. Source: packages/react/src/components/data-grid/
- Data table (data-table, stable): A table with sortable columns, row selection and pagination. Source: packages/react/src/components/data-table/
- Description list (description-list, stable): Label and value pairs, like the details of a record. Source: packages/react/src/components/description-list/
- Image (image, stable): An image with required alt text, a ratio, and a fallback when it fails to load. Source: packages/react/src/components/image/
- Image gallery (image-gallery, stable): A thumbnail grid that opens a lightbox with previous and next. Source: packages/react/src/components/image-gallery/
- Line chart (line-chart, stable): Show how one or more values change across an ordered axis, with straight or stepped lines. Source: packages/react/src/components/line-chart/
- Pie chart (pie-chart, stable): Parts of a whole as a pie, or a donut with innerRadius. Source: packages/react/src/components/pie-chart/
- Sortable list (sortable-list, stable): A list the user reorders by dragging a handle or with the keyboard, with live announcements. Source: packages/react/src/components/sortable-list/
- Sparkline (sparkline, stable): A tiny inline trend line for a table cell or a sentence. Source: packages/react/src/components/sparkline/
- Stat (stat, stable): One number with its label and a note. Source: packages/react/src/components/stat/
- Table (table, stable): Rows and columns of data with a header, in a horizontally scrolling wrapper. Source: packages/react/src/components/table/
- Tag (tag, stable): A short label, optionally removable. Source: packages/react/src/components/tag/
- Timeline (timeline, stable): A vertical list of events with times, joined by a rule. Source: packages/react/src/components/timeline/
- Tree (tree, stable): A nested list of items that open and close, with one selected item. Source: packages/react/src/components/tree/
- Virtual list (virtual-list, stable): A windowed list for thousands of rows: only the rows in view are in the page. Source: packages/react/src/components/virtual-list/

### feedback
- Alert (alert, stable): A message that stays on screen, with a title and a tone. Source: packages/react/src/components/alert/
- Empty state (empty-state, stable): Say that there is nothing here yet and offer the next step. Source: packages/react/src/components/empty-state/
- Notification center (notification-center, stable): A bell button with an unread count that opens a list of notifications, with mark read, clear and an empty state. Source: packages/react/src/components/notification-center/
- Progress (progress, stable): How far along a task is, or that it is still working. Source: packages/react/src/components/progress/
- Skeleton (skeleton, stable): A still placeholder shaped like the content that is loading. Source: packages/react/src/components/skeleton/
- Spinner (spinner, stable): A small indicator that something is loading. Source: packages/react/src/components/spinner/
- Toast (toast, stable): A short message that appears briefly and does not block the page. Source: packages/react/src/components/toast/

### overlays
- Alert dialog (alert-dialog, stable): A modal that interrupts to confirm a destructive or irreversible action. Source: packages/react/src/components/alert-dialog/
- Command (command, stable): A searchable palette of actions that opens over the page, with an optional global shortcut. Source: packages/react/src/components/command/
- Context menu (context-menu, stable): A menu of actions opened by right click or long press on an area. Source: packages/react/src/components/context-menu/
- Dialog (dialog, stable): A modal window for a question or short task that blocks the page. Source: packages/react/src/components/dialog/
- Drawer (drawer, stable): A panel that slides in from an edge for secondary tasks, details or navigation. Source: packages/react/src/components/drawer/
- Dropdown menu (dropdown-menu, stable): A list of actions that opens from a button. Source: packages/react/src/components/dropdown-menu/
- Hover card (hover-card, stable): Preview extra content when a link or element is hovered or focused. Source: packages/react/src/components/hover-card/
- Popover (popover, stable): A floating panel of content or controls anchored to a button. Source: packages/react/src/components/popover/
- Tooltip (tooltip, stable): Short hint text on hover and keyboard focus. Source: packages/react/src/components/tooltip/
- Tour (tour, stable): A guided walkthrough: a spotlight on one element at a time with a card and Next, Back and Skip. Source: packages/react/src/components/tour/

### navigation
- Breadcrumb (breadcrumb, stable): The path to the current page. Source: packages/react/src/components/breadcrumb/
- Menubar (menubar, stable): A horizontal bar of menus, like File, Edit and View in a desktop app. Source: packages/react/src/components/menubar/
- Navigation menu (navigation-menu, stable): Site navigation with links and menus that open panels of links. Source: packages/react/src/components/navigation-menu/
- Pagination (pagination, stable): Move between pages of results. Source: packages/react/src/components/pagination/
- Stepper (stepper, stable): Show progress through a numbered sequence of steps. Source: packages/react/src/components/stepper/
- Tabs (tabs, stable): Switch between related views in the same place. Source: packages/react/src/components/tabs/

### effects
- Animated list (animated-list, stable): A list whose items enter one by one without shifting the layout. Source: packages/react/src/components/animated-list/
- Bento grid (bento-grid, stable): A responsive asymmetric grid of cards with column and row spans. Source: packages/react/src/components/bento-grid/
- Border beam (border-beam, stable): A thin bordered box with a light that travels around its edge. CSS only. Source: packages/react/src/components/border-beam/
- Confetti (confetti, stable): A short burst of square confetti on a canvas, triggered by a prop or a ref method. Source: packages/react/src/components/confetti/
- Dot pattern (dot-pattern, stable): A decorative dot grid background drawn in SVG with currentColor. Source: packages/react/src/components/dot-pattern/
- Grid pattern (grid-pattern, stable): A decorative line grid background drawn in SVG with currentColor. Source: packages/react/src/components/grid-pattern/
- Marquee (marquee, stable): Scroll a row of items endlessly; pauses on hover and stops for reduced motion. Source: packages/react/src/components/marquee/
- Number ticker (number-ticker, stable): Count up to a number when it scrolls into view. Shows the final value at once for reduced motion. Source: packages/react/src/components/number-ticker/
- Orbiting circles (orbiting-circles, stable): Small items circling a centre. Decorative. Source: packages/react/src/components/orbiting-circles/
- Rolling number (rolling-number, stable): A number whose digits roll to the new value when it changes. Screen readers read the final value. Source: packages/react/src/components/rolling-number/
- Scroll progress (scroll-progress, stable): A thin bar fixed to the top of the window that fills as the page scrolls. Source: packages/react/src/components/scroll-progress/
- Shimmer button (shimmer-button, stable): The Button with a light sweep across it. Still a native button. Source: packages/react/src/components/shimmer-button/
- Spotlight (spotlight, stable): A surface with a soft highlight that follows the pointer. Source: packages/react/src/components/spotlight/
- Text reveal (text-reveal, stable): Fade a sentence in word by word. Static for reduced motion. Source: packages/react/src/components/text-reveal/
- Typewriter (typewriter, stable): Type a string one character at a time. Static for reduced motion. Source: packages/react/src/components/typewriter/

### blocks
- Call to action block (block-cta, beta): A closing call to action with one sentence and one next step. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-cta/
- Dashboard shell block (block-dashboard-shell, beta): App frame with sidebar, top bar and content that collapses to a drawer on small screens. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-dashboard-shell/
- Empty page block (block-empty-page, beta): A full-page message for not found, nothing yet or no access. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-empty-page/
- Feature grid block (block-feature-grid, beta): A section title above a responsive grid of short features. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-feature-grid/
- Footer block (block-footer, beta): A site footer with brand, link columns and small print. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-footer/
- Hero block (block-hero, beta): A page opener with eyebrow, title, description, actions and optional media. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-hero/
- Login block (block-login, beta): Email and password sign-in form with validation messages. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-login/
- Pricing block (block-pricing, beta): Plan cards with a monthly and yearly switch. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-pricing/
- Settings form block (block-settings-form, beta): Settings sections of switches and selects, each in a fieldset. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-settings-form/
- Sign-up block (block-signup, beta): Name, email and password account form with validation messages. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-signup/
- Testimonials block (block-testimonials, beta): Quotes with their authors, as figures with blockquotes. Source: packages/react/src/components/block-testimonials/

### hooks
- useClickOutside (use-click-outside, stable): Calls a function when a pointer goes down outside an element, to close menus and popovers. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-click-outside/
- useClipboard (use-clipboard, stable): Copy text with the Clipboard API, with a copied flag that resets after a delay and an error when it fails. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-clipboard/
- useControllableState (use-controllable-state, stable): The value, defaultValue and onChange pattern for custom components that can be controlled or uncontrolled. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-controllable-state/
- useCounter (use-counter, stable): A number with increment, decrement, set and reset, bounded by optional min and max. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-counter/
- useDebounce (use-debounce, stable): Debounced value and debounced callback: wait for input to settle before acting. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-debounce/
- useDisclosure (use-disclosure, stable): Open and closed state with open, close and toggle functions, and callbacks when it changes. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-disclosure/
- useDocumentTitle (use-document-title, stable): Set document.title while a component is mounted, then restore it. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-document-title/
- useFocusTrap (use-focus-trap, stable): Keeps Tab focus inside an element while it is active, and returns focus when it closes. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-focus-trap/
- useHash (use-hash, stable): Read and set location.hash as state. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-hash/
- useHotkeys (use-hotkeys, stable): Keyboard shortcuts such as mod+k or escape, ignored while typing in fields unless allowed. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-hotkeys/
- useHover (use-hover, stable): Track whether the pointer is over an element. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-hover/
- useIntersection (use-intersection, stable): Know whether an element is in view, with an IntersectionObserver. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-intersection/
- useInterval (use-interval, stable): Calls a function on a timer, with a null delay to pause it. Cleared on unmount. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-interval/
- useLocalStorage (use-local-storage, stable): A JSON value kept in localStorage, shaped like useState, that stays in sync across tabs. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-local-storage/
- useLongPress (use-long-press, stable): Call a handler when an element is held down, cancelling if the pointer moves or lifts early. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-long-press/
- useMediaQuery (use-media-query, stable): Whether a CSS media query matches, updated live, and safe to render on the server. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-media-query/
- useMounted (use-mounted, stable): True after the first client render. Use it to avoid server and client markup differences. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-mounted/
- usePrevious (use-previous, stable): The value from the previous render, for comparing a change. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-previous/
- useReducedMotion (use-reduced-motion, stable): Whether the user has asked the system to reduce motion, for skipping or simplifying animation in code. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-reduced-motion/
- useScrollSpy (use-scroll-spy, stable): Find which section is currently in view, for a table of contents or sticky nav. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-scroll-spy/
- useTimeout (use-timeout, stable): Run a callback after a delay, with start and clear controls. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-timeout/
- useToggle (use-toggle, stable): Cycle through a list of values, or flip a boolean. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-toggle/
- useWindowEvent (use-window-event, stable): Add a typed window event listener that is removed on unmount. Source: packages/react/src/hooks/use-window-event/
